product_one_liner.value: Sauce Labs provides a cloud platform for development and QA teams to run automated and manual web and mobile application tests across browsers, operating systems, and real and virtual devices.
product_one_liner.notes: The company’s assurance report describes its cloud testing platform, development and quality-team users, browser/OS/device coverage, and automated and manual testing: https://assets.ctfassets.net/vrc8wif0t20g/YTclSunvGnFtxRuGi2E0r/4356091bb20bb1c94bf1ca3d07caf17f/Sauce_Labs_2023_SOC_3_Report-Final.pdf.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists plans and published prices, including Live Testing: https://saucelabs.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Official customer case studies identify Walmart and Aryaka Networks as users: https://saucelabs.com/resources/case-studies/walmart-embraces-test-automation-and-open-source-to-increase-coverage-and-deploy-more-often and https://saucelabs.com/resources/case-studies/aryaka-networks-accelerates-end-to-end-platform-coverage-using-autonomiq-sauce-labs. | named_customers.0: The official case study says Walmart runs 50,000 tests per day on Sauce Labs. | named_customers.1: The official customer case study names Aryaka Networks as using Sauce Labs.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 331 employees, placing Sauce Labs in the 201–500 band. LinkedIn-associated headcount may differ from payroll headcount: https://linkedin.com/company/sauce-labs.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company assurance report explicitly states that Sauce Labs is headquartered in San Francisco, California: https://assets.ctfassets.net/vrc8wif0t20g/YTclSunvGnFtxRuGi2E0r/4356091bb20bb1c94bf1ca3d07caf17f/Sauce_Labs_2023_SOC_3_Report-Final.pdf. | hq_country: The company profile identifies the country as United States and the locality as San Francisco, California: https://linkedin.com/company/sauce-labs.

founded_year.notes: Sauce Labs’ LinkedIn company profile states that it was founded in 2008: https://linkedin.com/company/sauce-labs.

eng_blog.notes: The engineering blog contains Daniel Louvier’s infrastructure provisioning implementation and Farhan Iqbalhusain Chauhan’s React Network Viewer implementation, integrated into Sauce Labs. These are first-person engineering writeups, although the posts do not explicitly state the authors’ job titles. Sources: https://opensource.saucelabs.com/blog/ubuntu_autoinstall_and_iac_data_centers_operations/ and https://opensource.saucelabs.com/blog/react_network_viewer/.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation index links numerous product articles, including test authoring, generating tests, prompting and MCP tools: https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/index.html.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live AI Architect posting in Gurugram describes designing AI-powered continuous-testing capabilities, and the current job board lists the role: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/saucelabs/jobs/7096532.

model_provider.value: Google Gemini AI and Vertex API
model_provider.notes: The subprocessor disclosure names Google Cloud Platform, Gemini AI and Vertex API, and explicitly describes Gemini/Vertex use in natural-language queries, analysis and the support chatbot: https://trust.saucelabs.com/subprocessors.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The official security page names SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022 and GDPR. Only the requested compliance categories are included: https://www.saucelabs.com/security. | compliance_certs.0: The security page explicitly names SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.1: The security page explicitly names ISO 27001:2022. | compliance_certs.2: The security page explicitly names GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook labels the latest deal Debt, while Premier Alternatives specifies Debt - General. Both support reporting Debt rather than the earlier Series G equity stage: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/55089-10 and https://www.premieralts.com/companies/sauce-labs/funding-history. | funding_date: Premier Alternatives dates the last debt financing to June 2024; PitchBook independently identifies the latest deal type as Debt. This is later than the January 2024 equity round reported elsewhere, but the date is supported only by a secondary profile: https://www.premieralts.com/companies/sauce-labs/funding-history and https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/55089-10. | funding_amount_usd: The latest identified financing is listed as June 2024 debt with its amount undisclosed. The earlier January 2024 Series G amount is not substituted for this later financing: https://www.premieralts.com/companies/sauce-labs/funding-history.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified financing is debt dated June 2024, before the May 9, 2025 start of the eighteen-month window. No later financing was identified. This conclusion relies on secondary financing profiles rather than a dated company announcement: https://www.premieralts.com/companies/sauce-labs/funding-history and https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/55089-10.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Account Executive posting is for London, and the current job board lists it: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/saucelabs/jobs/8267329.

launched_6mo.notes: On September 29, 2026, Sauce Labs announced ARM-native Android virtual devices in its Virtual Device Cloud, a substantial new capability within the six-month window: https://saucelabs.com/company/news/sauce-labs-launches-the-industrys-first-arm-native-android-testing-cloud-for-the-enterprise-at-scale.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The April 16, 2026 announcement states that Steven Fitz joined as Chief Revenue Officer and Arun Lal as SVP of Global Marketing, within the requested twelve-month window: https://www.accessnewswire.com/newsroom/en/computers-technology-and-internet/sauce-labs-assembles-%22new-sauce%22-leadership-team-to-dominate-1157999.
